svg.title: EP2 C1 AREA 01
svg.desc: Temple is switch-heavy. Follow the numbered rooms and mechanism markers, and regroup only after each split is complete. Room 7 has a falling bell trap that can kill; know where it is and cover each other. Room 3 split: one player holds the blue switch so the solo player can pass the south fence; everyone else waits at the west door. The solo player breaks the walls and briefly steps on the orange switch to open the west door. Destroy the Foie traps that rise in the order south, west, north, then wait at the east door. Leave the traps to that one player. Room 4: clear the Monest and Mothmants and loot the southwest boxes, then take the red switch to the north and warp A→A′ back to room 3. Room 6 has 3 weapon boxes to its north; optional room 6a holds 7 boxes, 3 of them weapon boxes. Head east if short on time. Room 8: press the west switch to raise the bridge. One player holds the switch while the others warp B→B′, then waits for the south exit to open and rejoins at room 11.
